prompt:
A desktop landing page for "Cak Mimin — Bumbu Rujak Manis", an East Javanese family business selling ready-made sweet rujak dressing made with real palm sugar (gula aren asli) and no preservatives (tanpa pengawet). Rendered edge to edge as a finished web page, landscape 3:2, crisp readable Indonesian text, no browser window, device or desk around it.

The visitor is a home cook, a rujak seller or a traveller looking for oleh-oleh, deciding whether to order. This comp is led by one bold vertical move: a single thick ribbon of molten gula aren pours from the top edge of the page straight down through the first viewport and lands in a black stone cobek of glossy rujak sauce at the bottom, with sliced green mango and jambu air beside it. The huge headline is set beside the pour: "Manisnya dari nira, bukan dari pabrik." Subline: "Bumbu rujak manis racikan Cak Mimin. Gula aren asli, tanpa pengawet." Primary button: "Pesan via WhatsApp". A strict narrow left margin column numbers the journey stages 01 Nira, 02 Wajan, 03 Cobek, 04 Piring, with 01 highlighted, as the page's wayfinding.

Frame: wordmark "Cak Mimin" top left; navigation Cerita, Varian, Cara Ngerujak, Testimoni, Kemitraan; small WhatsApp order button top right.

Visual law: the ground is deep gula-aren brown, not cream, not white; caramel amber where the light hits the sugar. Banana-leaf green and chili red are the only accents. Bold, characterful high-contrast serif headlines; plain sturdy sans body. A faint batik kawung pattern pressed into the brown like an emboss. Real appetising food photography.
